changelog:
Initial release of Construction Progress Report Generator.

- Enables project managers to create structured, professional weekly or monthly construction progress reports via conversational input.
- Guides users step-by-step through all standard report sections (executive summary, progress vs. programme, milestones, critical path, risks, changes, resources, commercial summary, lookahead, and photos).
- Accepts informal user input and outputs a polished document suitable for clients and stakeholders.
- Proactively detects and highlights risks or issues based on user responses, even if not explicitly identified.
- Distinguishes between report types (weekly/monthly) and includes/excludes commercial summary accordingly.
summary: Help a project manager create a structured weekly or monthly construction progress report from conversational input, producing a polished professional document.
